movies.title: One Last Shot
movies.overview: Seasoned Navy SEAL Jake Harris is called back into action when the world is threatened by a former comrade. To track down and prevent the mastermind from extracting the nuclear codes, Harris must lead his team into enemy territory against a brutal barrage of mercenaries, deadly traps, and a reckoning with his own checkered past.

movies.title: Idiots
movies.overview: Two rock-bottom drivers transport a wealthy teen to rehab, but their simple job spirals into a chaotic journey of drugs, danger, and crime as their passenger derails their plans.

movies.title: Toy Story 5
movies.overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

movies.title: Ice Cream Man
movies.overview: An idyllic summer town descends into madness when an ice cream man serves kids sweet delights with horrifying results.

movies.title: Super Troopers 3
movies.overview: When Farva’s wildly over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny’s sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny’s schemes to break up the relationship, while trying to crack a pernicious new drug ring  — all to save the day and maybe the wedding itself.

movies.title: Backrooms
movies.overview: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.

movies.title: Obsession
movies.overview: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

movies.title: The End of Oak Street
movies.overview: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

movies.title: Legend of the White Dragon
movies.overview: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

movies.title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
movies.overview: After years of slapdash sequels, the Camp Miasma franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the original’s star, a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.
